Foo Scrobbler for Mac

By: zfox

Foo Scrobbler for Mac (foo_scrobbler_mac) is a Last.fm scrobbling component for foobar2000 on macOS.

Submits tracks based on precise playback rules, caches scrobbles when offline, and operates silently after one-time authentication. It focuses on reliability, low overhead, and correct metadata handling, while offering advanced scrobbling features.

After the first-time installation, go to the Playback menu and select Last.fm → Authenticate with your Last.fm account. You can then start scrobbling.

Current version: 2.0.1, released on 2026-10-02

Download

Change log:

-Extend handling of NowPlaying for Stop/Pause on all use cases.
-Fix console logging of per-scrobble Last.fm refusals within batches.
-Fix parsing of local tracks without Artist field, to avoid NP dispatch.

Supported system: macOS.

Works with foobar2000 v2.24 and newer.
